title: Use in a ParallelPipeline
content:
pipeline = Pipeline([
    transport.input(),
    ParallelPipeline(
        # Branch 1: LLM for bot responses
        [
            llm,
            tts,
            producer,  # Capture TTS audio here
        ],
        # Branch 2: Audio processing branch
        [
            consumer,  # Receive TTS audio here
            llm, # Speech-to-Speech LLM (audio in)
        ]
    ),
    transport.output(),
])
```
